statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
Continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period is needed
The service was ordered to capture and characterize underlying arrhythmias
Diagnosis codes I47.1, I48.0, and I49.9 were associated with this service
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
